        vertices.append((x, y))
    return vertices

    vertices = hexagon_vertices(hex_center_x, hex_center_y, angle_deg)
    outer_vertices = hexagon_vertices(0, 0, 0, outer_hex_radius)
    outer_polygon = Polygon(outer_vertices)

    return True
